Senses.Explanation: The seven buddhas are the inherited group preceding and including Shakyamuni that the records place at the head of the transmitted line. Masters cite their verse lineage, ritual forms, halls, and Manjushri’s relation to them, bringing the group into present questions rather than offering seven separate biographies.
